canonical_sources.meaning: Classify terminal branches and preserve durable evidence outside redundant operational refs/worktrees.

Remove completed clean worktree when purpose ends; require exacthead, ownership, reachability, one explicit disposition and terminal evidence; do not force-remove dirty/unknown/user-owned/locked/unique resources.
Record exact path/head, retained-ref or archive protection, disposition/outcome and post-removal absence; protected-OID pre/post comparison required when removing reachability root.
Integration owner owns serial integration and hands off only predeclared cleanup with Commit reachability/disposition evidence.
Plan-author worktree stays for review/handoff; later cleanup requires clean state, reachability and safely merged dependent-branch evidence. Does not state latest-main CI prerequisite.
Full exact-head CI/cross-owner review/lead approval is before production activation, not a generic branch/worktree-removal prerequisite.
Historical parent-monitored postmerge acceptance and retained branches are observations, not a normative statement that all future resource cleanup waits latest-main CI.

concrete_conditions_that_remain: Only declared task-owned candidates with terminal purpose ended and durable accepted/merged evidence; broader active plan can remain open without automatically retaining unrelated completed resources.
Confirm exact path/branch/head/cleanliness/lock/registration and open dependent-consumer state immediately before cleanup. Inventory snapshot is evidence of prior state, not current authorization.

Protect exact head OIDs through verified named retained refs or exact archives and compare protected OIDs before/after any reachability-root removal. Ancestry to a literal old mainOID alone is not the complete final record.

Preserve all original82refs/96worktrees, PR91 draft and unrelated/unmerged/checkpoint/integration/fix branches. PR89/90 same-name local refs are absent; aliases are not inferred targets from matching SHA.

Document resource-specific continuing qualification/handoff purpose if retained; actual ongoing work can require retention, but that is a concrete lifecycle fact rather than an automatic latest-main CI gate.

gate_origin.assessment: This gate is explicitly labelled parent-imposed in the inventory; no matching blanket dependency found in canonical source. Root may revise its own sequencing without waiving named evidence. The current instruction explicitly says no cleanup yet and remains controlling.
literal_cleanup_authorization: PENDING parent final postmerge CI gate and immediate identity/status/dependency recheck; inventory only
